continuous_density_measures.measure_provenance: Continuous P0 density; no strong-station nodal atoms; root origin/arms explicit.

root_provenance: First P0 support allocates interface action to fixed root nodes; root G alone is not actual ground. Beam root DOFs1..5 direct ground, DOF6 free. Root repartition retained.
sign_provenance: G element resisting, L applied; +C^T lambda connection resisting; -C^T lambda connection exerted; actual ground=(G+C^T lambda-L) on fixed DOFs only. No raw nodeReaction.
units: C translation rows m^2, director rows m; lambda=(N/m,Nm/m); average gaps m/rad. Lref1m.
